data.one_liner: A customisable toggle tab widget for Flutter with animated selection and adaptive widths.
data.what_it_does: Provides a toggle tab widget supporting text, icons, and counter widgets. It features animated indicators, gradients, custom margins, and adaptive widths.
use_when: You need a segmented control or toggle tab widget to switch between different views.
You require customizable tab indicators with animations, icons, or badges.
avoid_when: You need a complex tab navigation system with page views or multiple full screens (use Flutter's default TabBar instead).
Your application is using legacy material imports and hasn't upgraded to Flutter 3.47 and the standalone material_ui package.
strengths: Supports adaptive widths, icons, badges, and gradient backgrounds.
Includes animated selection indicators with customizable duration and curves.
Uses local ValueNotifier state management for optimized rebuilding.
weaknesses: Requires Flutter 3.47+ and Dart 3.13+, which may be too new for older projects.
Depends on the standalone material_ui package.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_toggle_tab and material_ui to pubspec.yaml and ensure Flutter 3.47+ requirements are met.
data.minimal_example:
ValueListenableBuilder<int>(
  valueListenable: selectedIndex,
  builder: (context, currentIndex, _) => FlutterToggleTab(
    width: 90,
    borderRadius: 30,
    dataTabs: [
      DataTab(title: 'Popular'),
      DataTab(title: 'Recent'),
    ],
    selectedIndex: currentIndex,
    selectedLabelIndex: (index) => selectedIndex.value = index,
  ),
)
